belje.title: Could you spare some potatoes?
lines: I haven't been able to get any potatoes lately. The ranch keeps me so busy I can't find time to shop.
If you happen to have some {item_name}, could you share a few?
I'll make sure to pay you back for your kindness.

flora.title: I urgently need lettuce!
lines: I've just run out of lettuce. I've got no salad to serve my customers!
If you have some {item_name}, could you share some? It's really urgent!
I'll pay you back, I promise!

isha.title: I have a small favor to ask
lines: I've been watching my stamina lately, and I've just run out of {item_name}.
I know it's a bother to ask, but could you possibly spare some?
I'll settle up right away once I receive it.

marin.title: Can you get me some mackerel?!
lines: Hey, {player_name}! I want a mackerel dish today but I don't have a single one.
Do you have any {item_name}? If you do, give me some!
I'll definitely pay you back next time, promise!

marr.title: I require salmon.
lines: I have run out of salmon.
If you have {item_name}, please share some.
I will pay the exact price.

mocha.title: Could I get some berries?
lines: I ran out of berries for the desserts. Of all days, a busy one.
If you've got some {item_name}, could you share? I'm in a rush.
I'll pay you back with a cup of coffee.

roshi.title: I'd ask you for some corn
lines: I could use some corn, but I've been so busy on the boat I haven't had time to shop.
If you happen to have some {item_name}, would you spare some?
I'll pay you well, that's certain.

shepherd.title: Could you get me some squid?
lines: Lately my appetite keeps drifting toward squid.
If you have some {item_name}, could you share some?
I'll gladly take it, and I'll pay you generously.

usher.title: Mind if I talk about berries?
lines: Berries, you know, burst with a little pop each time you bite. Doesn't that feel like a tiny story?
I'm a bit short on stories lately, so, could you share some {item_name}?
I'll pay you well. Think of it as payment for the story.

woody.title: Got any potatoes?
lines: I was going to eat a potato dish today, but there wasn't a single one.
If you've got any {item_name} to spare, could you give me some?
Thanks, really! Next time I'll give you something in return.
